mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% over 12-month rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals labor market improvement that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0% and declines.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a shift from residential investment to consumer spending, signaling economic resilience and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST decline + RSAFS rise) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 95.0) above its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: In low-employment growth regimes (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% monthly), a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is below 0.5% and UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in CPIAUCSL indicates monetary policy response to inflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as markets anticipate growth support.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline + CPIAUCSL rise) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
